title: A unified framework for original energy dissipation of equilibrium-preserving exponential Runge--Kutta methods for $L^2$ gradient flows
summary: This paper develops a unified framework for establishing original energy dissipation of equilibrium-preserving exponential time differencing Runge--Kutta (ETDRK) methods for $L^2$ gradient flows. The analysis is based on an auxiliary continuous evolution representation of a general ETDRK method, which allows the energy variation to be controlled without imposing positive-definiteness conditions on the Butcher coefficients or introducing stabilization terms.
